finding.text: Push-to-talk itself was never shown working: the headless proof failed holding the button, the toggle and the mic click (ptt-proof/results.json checks 1, 2, 4), and nothing was re-run after the one-line fix in push-to-talk.js. Requirements 2–4 are still unproven.

The review shots are all Chrome's "This site can't be reached" page (shots/…Hotkeys/sheet.png; layout.json widest_text_sample "This site can't be reached" at every width). So no width was measured. The visual answers below come from the builder's own ptt-proof/5-settings-hotkeys.png at 1920 only. Re-shoot before merge.

Settings labels break mid-word: "dictati / on", "(modif / iers)". The label column is squeezed to about 3.5em, both in the drawer's Settings tab and on the demo page (Wrapping; ptt-proof/5-settings-hotkeys.png, both the right panel and the stage). Let the label take its natural width, or put it on its own line.

Capture has no cancel and accepts the left mouse button. After clicking "press a key or button…", the next click anywhere, even one meant to back out, becomes the binding (row.js `capture`, Hotkeys.js `button()`). If that happens on push-to-talk, every ordinary click starts recording. Ignore button 0 and let Escape cancel.

The default toggle, Ctrl+Shift+M, is Chrome's own profile-menu shortcut on Windows, so the browser may take it before the page sees it. Ctrl+Shift+M is the owner's own wording, though, so test it live before changing it.

A bare-key binding also fires while typing in a text box, because Hotkeys never checks what has focus. And if the window loses focus while the button is held, the mic stays on, because no "up" ever arrives. Neither bites the default mouse-button-4 binding.
`ux/page.js` `children:` doesn't name Hotkeys. The page loads (proof shot), but it is missing from the UX wall. ux/Dictate's readme doesn't mention push-to-talk.
The double-send risk across two mounts, found in ptt-proof/proof.md check 7, comes from chat.js and is not new here. It still owes a live count of the requests sent.

A hotkey on a modifier key never fires, or never releases (requirement 1). `Hotkeys.matches()` requires exact modifier flags, but pressing AltRight sets `altKey: true` on its own keydown and `false` on its keyup. So the readme's own example `{ code: "AltRight" }` never fires. A captured AltRight or Ctrl binding fires "down" but never "up", so push-to-talk keeps recording after release. Releasing Ctrl before M on a Ctrl+Shift+M push binding gets stuck the same way. Fix: match "up" on `code` alone, and ignore a key's own modifier flag. — diff `Hotkeys.js` `key()` / `matches()`.

Push-to-talk is off by default, so the owner's ask "go somewhere and set the key, then go anywhere… I hit push-to-talk" does not work out of the box (requirement 2). A second checkbox in Settings has to be found first. The reason is real: two mounts send one utterance twice (ptt-proof check 7). But the fix belongs in `chat.js` (a cross-mount send guard), and that guard is still open, so the feature ships disabled. — diff `push-to-talk.js` `mic_pref`, `settings.js`.

The level-driven size was proven only with a hand-set `--mic-level`; the real meter wiring was never seen working. `ensure_mount()` sets `on_meter` only if `mount.panel.dictate` already exists at mount time, and the real-mic run logged a worklet AbortError (ptt-proof check 6). — `ptt-proof/proof.md` checks 3 and 6.

Hotkeys fire while the reader is typing. Nothing checks for an input or textarea, so if push-to-talk is rebound to a plain key (the proof rebinds it to "9"), typing that key in any field starts dictation. On the Hotkeys page, typing "h" in the filter fires `demo.example`. — diff `Hotkeys.js` `key()`.

The two demo actions are registered when `ux/Hotkeys/page.js` is imported. After that, they appear in the real drawer Settings list on every page ("Demo action (try me)", "Demo toggle (modifiers)"), mixed in with the real hotkeys. — `shots/…Hotkeys/400.png`, the four rows.

At 400, each "press a key or button…" button wraps to 2 lines (layout.json `wraps`, 3 of them) and sits on its own row under the binding. At 1920 and 3440, the bled demo stage is a wide box that is mostly empty. — `shots/…Hotkeys/400.png`, `1920.png`.
`FloatingMic.css` uses literal colours (`#fff`, `rgba(0,0,0,.25)`), not tokens (colour 3). The filter input carries `dev-hotkeys-filter`, a class no stylesheet defines (css 42).

Mouse buttons 3 and 4 always have their default action blocked, on every page, even when nothing is bound to them or push-to-talk is off. That means the browser's back and forward thumb buttons stop working site-wide. It is deliberate (Hotkeys `doc/decisions.md`), but the owner should know.
